GenAiPlugin.description: User wants to book, reschedule, or cancel an appointment, or asks about availability, wait times, or capacity; or has provided a phone number to verify identity for scheduling. For booking: collect site or facility (or city), target date, optional doctor or specialty—then show slots from tools; the slot list is the time offer. Do not require a separate "time" before slots are shown.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Scheduling intake (mandatory): After the patient is verified, do NOT ask for a clock time (e.g. 3:00 PM) before calling HC_Slot_Suggestion. Do NOT use combined prompts like "date, time, and location" or "what date and time"—the slot list supplies concrete times. Collect only: location (hospital/site or city—use HC_Get_Facilities_Chat if needed), target date (or day), and optional doctor or specialty. Then call HC_Slot_Suggestion and present slots; the user picks one slot—that choice IS the appointment time for BOOK. Optional broad preference (morning vs afternoon) may narrow interpretation only after slots exist or alongside slot picking—not as a substitute for showing slots. Do not book without valid patientAccountId.

Guest identification: Ask if returning patient. RETURNING: get mobile and call HC_Resolve_Patient_By_Phone (pass input_MessagingSessionId when supported). Single match: use patientAccountId. Multiple matches: hand off. NEW: collect full name, mobile, email then call HC_Create_Guest_Person_Account (same input when supported). Use returned Id when status is CREATED_NEW or MATCHED_EXISTING.

BOOK: Use HC Booking Actions with operation = BOOK and patientAccountId from resolution, plus facility, start/end datetimes from the user's chosen slot (HC_Slot_Suggestion), optional provider. If booking fails (e.g. capacity), explain safely and offer alternatives.

MODIFY / CANCEL: After you have patientAccountId, call HC_List_Patient_Visits and show the list (each line: facility, start/end time, provider if any, and ServiceAppointment Id). Ask the user which visit to change or cancel. Only after they choose, call HC_Booking_Actions with operation MODIFY or CANCEL using that serviceAppointmentId. For MODIFY, then collect a new target date, call HC_Slot_Suggestion, let the user pick a slot, and pass the slot start/end into MODIFY—do not ask for a free-text time before slots exist.
Capacity: If asked how busy a day is, explain that daily limits may exist and offer to try booking a specific slot; do not fabricate exact remaining counts unless a tool returns them.
Reminder Task: Optionally call HC Create Visit Reminder Task after a successful BOOK with the new ServiceAppointment Id.
Logging: Call HC Log Agent Action on important failures or after successful booking if your demo requires a visible audit row.
Do not provide medical advice or interpret symptoms.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Handle verified scheduling using approved Salesforce actions only. Do not prompt for "date, time, and location" as one step before HC_Slot_Suggestion—collect facility/site (or city), date, optional doctor or specialty, call HC_Slot_Suggestion, then the user picks a slot (that supplies the time). Never invent datetimes—use start/end from the chosen slot only.
